CFML Language Reference: Functions

Right

Returns the given number of characters from the end of a string.

Category

String functions

Syntax

Right(string, count)

Parameters

string
The source string.
count
How many characters to return. Must not be negative.

Returns

The last count characters. If count is larger than the string, the whole string is returned.

Usage

Classic uses: file extensions, the last four digits of an account number, and padding numbers with zeros (Right("000" & n, 3)).

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Files = "report.cfm,logo.gif,readme.txt">
<CFOUTPUT>
<UL>
<CFLOOP LIST="#Files#" INDEX="f">
<LI>#f# has the extension #Right(f, 3)#
</CFLOOP>
<LI>Order number #Right("00000" & 42, 5)#
</UL>
</CFOUTPUT>

Left, Mid, Len, ListLast
